content.user_title: Build Full-Stack Apps from Natural Language
content.value_statement: Turning an app idea into an implementation plan can be slow and inconsistent. App Builder classifies the project, selects a stack, and coordinates agents through delivery.
actual_capabilities: Detects project type from request keywords such as SaaS, dashboard, API, mobile, desktop, and CLI.
Recommends default and alternative technology stacks for full-stack web applications.
Defines a feature-based Next.js project structure with core files and path aliases.
Coordinates planner, database, backend, frontend, security, test, and DevOps agent phases.
Guides feature additions with change analysis, user approval, testing, preview, and recovery steps.
limitations: It provides orchestration guidance, not executable scaffolding scripts.
Referenced template files are not included in this package.
Technology recommendations may need updates as frameworks and runtimes change.
Deployment and validation depend on compatible tools, agents, and project access.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic App Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a plan for a task management web app. Include project type, recommended stack, main pages, and required data models.

prompt_templates.title: Select a Stack
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this app idea and choose a practical full-stack technology stack. Explain the default choice and any useful alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Add payments to this existing application. Identify database changes, backend routes, frontend screens, dependencies, tests, and rollout steps.

prompt_templates.title: Orchestrate Multi-Agent Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased delivery plan for a marketplace app. Assign work to planner, database, backend, frontend, test, security, and DevOps agents.

output_examples.input: Create an Instagram-style photo sharing app.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies a social media app, recommends a full-stack web stack, outlines users, posts, likes, follows, upload pages, and agent phases.

output_examples.input: Add Stripe checkout to my app.
output_examples.output: The skill lists payment tables, checkout routes, webhook handling, checkout UI, required dependencies, testing steps, and recovery options.

output_examples.input: Build a browser extension for saving links.
output_examples.output: The skill detects a browser extension project, selects the Chrome extension template path, and plans storage, popup UI, permissions, and validation tasks.

best_practices: Provide the target platform, user roles, core workflows, and integrations in the first request.
Review the generated plan before allowing specialist agents to change files.
Keep secrets in local environment files and document only placeholder values.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before project type, stack, and missing requirements are clear.
Skipping plan verification before assigning work to specialist agents.
Using the default stack without checking platform, hosting, team, and compliance needs.

faq.question: What does App Builder do?
faq.answer: It turns natural language app ideas into project classification, stack choices, structure guidance, and coordinated agent work.

faq.question: Can it write the full application by itself?
faq.answer: It orchestrates planning and agent coordination. Actual implementation depends on the available editor, shell, agents, and project permissions.

faq.question: Which project types does it recognize?
faq.answer: It covers blogs, ecommerce, dashboards, APIs, mobile apps, portfolios, SaaS, documentation, extensions, desktop apps, CLI tools, and monorepos.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.

faq.question: Does it include ready-made templates?
faq.answer: No. The package references template names, but the reviewed file set does not include those template files.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with secrets?
faq.answer: Use placeholder values in examples. Keep real credentials outside prompts and committed files.
